summary: The bill bars federal agencies and courts from restricting or regulating interstate shipments of unpasteurized milk and milk products packaged for direct human consumption when both the origin and destination states permit such sales and the products meet the origin state's labeling and other rules.

scores.thoughts: The bill contains no provisions related to federal spending, appropriations, or budget allocations. It solely addresses regulatory prohibitions on interstate commerce of raw milk.
No tax provisions, rate changes, credits, or revenue measures appear in the bill text.

While the bill overrides certain FDA food-safety rules, the healthcare topic is narrowly defined around coverage models (public vs. private insurance). This legislation does not address insurance, coverage, or healthcare delivery systems.
The bill has no connection to firearms, gun regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
No immigration, border, or visa-related content exists in the legislation.
The bill does not address reproductive rights, abortion access, or related healthcare services.

No welfare, nutrition assistance, or social safety-net programs are mentioned or altered.

The legislation concerns only interstate (domestic) commerce and explicitly does not preempt state laws; it has no bearing on international trade, tariffs, or globalization.
